name: The Collapsing Star
intro: You look into the bead of black glass — and you are inside it. Brass rings the size of cities turn around you, and at the heart of everything a star is dying.

rooms.name: The Collapsing Star - The Shattered Orrery
rooms.description: The broken rings of a vast brass orrery turn slowly overhead, each carrying the ghost of a planet. North, two rings have locked together across the only way on.

rooms.name: The Collapsing Star - The Event Horizon
rooms.description: Here the light bends. Stones float loose of the ground and drift toward the north, where a rift in the dark opens onto something very bright and very hungry.

rooms.name: The Collapsing Star - The Heart of the Void
rooms.description: A dying star hangs in the dark, the size of a house and the colour of a bruise. Something long and black is coiled around it, drinking.

waves.text: Star-wrought sentinels grind to life among the broken rings of the orrery!
Things pulled from other worlds tumble out of the dark!
Gravity motes spiral in from every side!

gates.text: The orrery's rings swing apart — the way to the horizon is open.
The horizon tears open on the heart of the void.

boss.text: Vaelith the Star-Eater uncoils from the dying star. 'Another moth,' she says. 'Come closer. Everything does, in the end.'
